agents.name: SQL DB Agent
agents.description: Enterprise-grade SQL assistant built for extra-large datasets and complex queries. Schema-grounded NL-to-SQL with EXPLAIN plan analysis, query-timeout protection, table-size and index awareness, two-pass schema selection for 150+ table databases, parallel step execution, paginated results, 5-min result caching, and optimisation-aware prompt engineering. Supports ERD generation, governed CRUD (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), RBAC, audit logging, and CREATE TEMP TABLE for analytical workflows.
capabilities: Natural language to schema-aware, performance-optimised SQL
SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE with validation
Multi-step query planning with parallel execution of independent steps
EXPLAIN plan analysis with cost, row-estimate, and sequential-scan warnings
Query timeout protection (30 s per statement, per-dialect)
Table row-count and index awareness in schema context
Two-pass schema selection for databases with 150+ tables
Paginated result delivery with page/page_size controls
Short-TTL result caching (5 min per session) for repeated queries
Memory-safe chunked fetching for wide/large result sets
CREATE TEMP TABLE support for complex analytical workflows
Conversation history summarisation for long sessions
Result formatting, summaries, and LLM-powered insights
Dangerous DDL blocked unless explicitly authorized
Audit logging of all SQL actions

tools.name: schema_introspection
tools.description: Reflect tables, columns, PKs, FKs, indexes, and approximate row counts from the live database. Two-pass mode for large schemas (150+ tables): lightweight summary first, then full detail for relevant tables only.

tools.name: sql_guard
tools.description: Parse, classify, RBAC-check, schema-validate, and audit-log every statement. Blocks destructive DDL unless admin-authorised. Allows CREATE TEMP TABLE for writer+ roles.

tools.name: sql_executor
tools.description: Execute validated statements with per-dialect statement timeouts, chunked result fetching (5 K row batches), and structured row-set return.

tools.name: explain_analyzer
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN (PostgreSQL JSON, MySQL, SQLite QUERY PLAN) before execution. Warns on estimated cost > 50 K, row scan > 500 K, or sequential scans on large tables.

tools.name: llm_plan
tools.description: PwC GenAI for NL-to-SQL orchestration with optimisation rules (no SELECT * on large tables, push filters early, prefer indexed columns, use CTEs), plan completeness review, and narrative formatting.

tools.name: result_cache
tools.description: Short-TTL (5 min) per-session cache. Identical SQL plans return instantly without re-execution.

llm_providers.name: PwC GenAI (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)
llm_providers.description: Planning, SQL synthesis, and answer formatting

agents.name: AI ETL Agent
agents.description: An intelligent AI ETL agent: connect a mandatory source database (SQLAlchemy URL) and an optional destination database. It introspects both schemas (ERD) into session memory, extracts read-only data from the source (or accepts pasted CSV/JSON), plans and generates Pandas code, runs it in a sandbox, shows results, and can load transformed rows to the destination when you ask.
capabilities: Smart tool routing (Pandas / SQL / Direct LLM)
Safe Pandas code generation with static analysis
Sandboxed execution with timeout & memory limits
Source/destination SQL databases with ERD introspection (SQLAlchemy)
Read-only SQL extract from source and optional write to destination

tools.name: db_introspection
tools.description: Connect to source/destination DBs, build ERD text for LLM context, run validated read-only SELECTs, and load transformed DataFrames

tools.name: schema_extractor

tools.name: code_generator
tools.description: Generate safe, optimized Pandas code with static validation (blocked imports, required result variable)

tools.name: sandbox_executor
tools.description: Execute generated code in a restricted sandbox with timeout, memory limits, and whitelisted builtins

tools.name: validator

agents.name: Browser Automation Agent
agents.description: An AI agent that converts natural language instructions into real browser automation. Describe what you want to do (visit sites, search products, add to cart, fill forms) and the agent plans steps, launches a visible Chrome browser, executes each action with Playwright, captures screenshots, and generates a re-runnable Python script — all with full step-by-step logging.
capabilities: Self-healing: LLM retries failed steps with corrected code
agents.architecture_diagram_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph L0["L0 · Ingress / session"]
        START([NL goal + URL anchors])
        START --> SESS{Warm session?}
        SESS -->|yes| HYDR[Rehydrate chat + memory]
        SESS -->|no| NEWID[Allocate session scope]
        HYDR --> NORM
        NEWID --> NORM[Normalize intent + caps]
    end
    subgraph L1["L1 · Planning and guardrails"]
        NORM --> PLAN[LLM step decomposition]
        PLAN --> VAL{Schema + policy OK?}
        VAL -->|no| REFINE[Trim or regenerate plan]
        REFINE --> PLAN
        VAL -->|yes| CHK[Ordered checklist JSON]
    end
    subgraph L2["L2 · Browser runtime"]
        CHK --> POOL[Acquire Chromium from pool]
        POOL --> MODE{Headed profile?}
        MODE -->|yes| VISIBLE[Visible Playwright]
        MODE -->|no| HEADL[Headless worker]
        VISIBLE --> RDY
        HEADL --> RDY[Session bound to run ID]
    end
    subgraph L3["L3 · Execution loop"]
        RDY --> SNAP[DOM + a11y snapshot]
        SNAP --> PROP[Structured action proposal]
        PROP --> EXEC[Deterministic executor]
        EXEC --> EVID[Logs + PNG evidence]
        EVID --> STEPOK{Step OK?}
        STEPOK -->|no| HEAL[LLM self-heal slice]
        HEAL --> PROP
        STEPOK -->|yes| MORE{More steps?}
        MORE -->|yes| SNAP
        MORE -->|no| FIN
    end
    subgraph L4["L4 · Egress / artifacts"]
        FIN([Run complete])
        FIN --> SUM[Streaming chat summary]
        FIN --> RPT[(HTML report bundle)]
        FIN --> PY[/export_playwright.py/]
        PY --> MEMSV[Persist session for follow-up]
    end
    classDef decision fill:#422006,stroke:#fbbf24,stroke-width:2px,color:#fef9c3
    classDef terminal fill:#0c4a6e,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:2.5px,color:#e0f2fe
    classDef datastore fill:#14532d,stroke:#4ade80,stroke-width:2px,color:#dcfce7
    classDef ioshape fill:#1e3a5f,stroke:#60a5fa,stroke-width:2px,color:#dbeafe
    class SESS,VAL,MODE,STEPOK,MORE decision
    class START,FIN terminal
    class RPT datastore
    class PY ioshape
